correctness.rationale: An exhaustive 13-point incidence lemma leaves the 234 vertexless triangles as only nontrivial minimal blocking point sets. Cubic interpolation through a fixed triangle gives a 4-dimensional system; four rational-point checks plus the four-collinear-points factor criterion leave exactly four equations per triangle. The characteristic-three Jacobian identities exclude singular points over the algebraic closure, and orbit-stabilizer yields group order 6. A separate standard-library program exhaustively checks 29524 ternary cubics and the 936 count; it does not substitute finite enumeration for geometric smoothness.

value.rationale: For the exceptional first odd prime field where blocking cubics do exist, it settles the natural global classification of irreducible cubic curves by rational projective equivalence, identifies their unique rational point-set type, gives an exact orbit count of 936 and full S3 stabilizer. The classification is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of incidence point-set counts.
